name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A table people filter, sort and page through: a dropdown per filter, heads in capitals that sort, 40px rows on neutral hairlines that take the #262626 fill under the pointer, numbers in tabular figures, Previous and Next under it. It scrolls sideways with fading edges inside the frame.
use_for: A board's creatives, a brand's ads, a team's searches: rows of one kind of thing that people narrow and order.
never: Zebra stripes or a shadow: hairlines separate rows
Bold heads: DM Sans Medium capitals at 6%
A spectrum color for a sorted column or a picked filter
A table wider than the page without its own scroll
source: Derived from the guidelines: DM Sans for cells and capital labels for heads, neutral hairlines, the #262626 card fill for the hovered row and the filter menus, the 10px canvas corner (8px here). shadcn's data table (filters, sortable heads, pagination) for anatomy and ARIA.

examples.name: Creatives
examples.label: A board's creatives
examples.content:
'use client' import { DataTable } from '@/react/components/ui/DataTable' // A board's creatives on sample data: filter by format and status, sort by days running, spend or impressions, five // to a page. const formats = ['Video', 'Carousel', 'Image'] const statuses = ['Active', 'Paused'] const names = ['summer UGC', 'serum launch', 'founder story', 'bundle offer', 'before and after', 'unboxing', 'routine in 30 seconds', 'holiday gift set'] const rows = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `cr-${i + 1}`, name: `Acme ${names[i % names.length]!}${i >= names.length ? ` ${Math.floor(i / names.length) + 1}` : ''}`, format: formats[i % 3]!, status: statuses[i % 4 === 3 ? 1 : 0]!, days: ((i * 17) % 80) + 3, spend: ((i * 7919) % 42000) + 1800, impressions: ((i * 104729) % 2400000) + 86000, })) const columns = [ { key: 'name', label: 'Creative', sortable: true }, { key: 'format', label: 'Format' }, { key: 'status', label: 'Status', muted: true }, { key: 'days', label: 'Days running', align: 'right' as const, sortable: true }, { key: 'spend', label: 'Spend', align: 'right' as const, sortable: true }, { key: 'impressions', label: 'Impressions', align: 'right' as const, sortable: true }, ] const filters = [{ key: 'format', label: 'Format', options: formats }, { key: 'status', label: 'Status', options: statuses }] export default function Creatives() { return (
`$${Number(value).toLocaleString('en-US')}` }} />
) }
